notes:
### Descriptions work on light hardware again
- **The Fast describe tier runs on Moondream** — clip descriptions (and
  description-based search) on ordinary laptops, no GPU-hungry video model
  required. Rich (Qwen) is unchanged for capable machines.
- **Rich degrades honestly.** When Rich struggles it now steps down within
  the Qwen family — smaller model, fewer frames, lower resolution — and if
  the hardware truly can't keep up it says so and suggests Fast, instead of
  failing silently.
- **Describe reliability:** "too slow" verdicts and calibration budgets are
  per model, so one slow model no longer disables the rest; redundant model
  reloads are gone; evicted models free their memory on Apple Silicon too.
- **Archive Index describes clips in a separate process** — a model crash
  can't take the app down.

### Fixes and tools
- The Previews progress bar only counts footage actually on disk, so it can
  reach done.
- Deliver: chapters are editable in one place, and the schedule time you set
  is used.
- Social Distribute: one vertical export posts to four platforms.
- Thumbnail Lab: design vertical 9:16 covers alongside 16:9 thumbnails.
- Resolve placement survives a minimized Resolve window.
- AI spend: every cloud call is recorded — real usage, not estimates.
